200.description: List of models in JSON format

schema.description: Response wrapper for the `/v1/models` endpoint (OpenAI-compatible format).

items.description: Model information returned in the `/v1/models` response (OpenAI-compatible format).

datasets.description: The datasets associated with this model, if any

oneOf.description:
An optional error type/code for the model status.
Only populated when `status=true` and the model status is `Error`.
Example:
`{ "category": "model", "type": "auth", "code": "model.auth" }`.

category.description: High-level component category where the error originated.
category.title: ComponentErrorCategory

type.description: Canonical error type intended for programmatic handling.
type.title: ComponentErrorType

oneOf.title: ComponentError

error_message.description:
An optional error message describing why the model entered an error state.
Only populated when `status=true`, the model status is `Error`, and an error message was recorded.
This value is intended for user-visible display.

oneOf.description: Optional metadata fields, included when requested via query parameters

supports_responses_api.description: Whether this model supports the Responses API

oneOf.title: ModelMetadata

owned_by.description: The source from which the model was loaded (e.g., `openai`, `spiceai`)

oneOf.description: The component is initializing and not yet ready
The component is ready to accept connections
The component is disabled and not running
An error occurred in the component, with an optional error message

Error.description: An error occurred in the component, with an optional error message

oneOf.description: The component is in the process of refreshing its state
The component is in the process of shutting down

items.title: ModelInfo

schema.title: ModelListResponse

500.description: Internal server error occurred while processing models
